name: Stonesense
body:
School divination; Level cleric/oracle 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (bit of dwarf hair)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell, you gain the stonecunning ability, as a dwarf . If you already have the stonecunning ability, this spell adds a +5 insight bonus on any Perception checks to notice unusual stonework.
